name: Customer Operations, VIP Escalation & Knowledge Quality
description: Scores VIP account escalations by ARR exposure and Sev1 outages, mines CSAT/NPS verbatims into ARR-weighted driver paretos with null-rating hygiene, and validates support troubleshooting decision trees for graph defects.

skills.summary: Scores VIP account escalations (0-100) from Sev1/Sev2 cases, SLA breaches, ARR, imminent renewals, outages, and competitor risk.
Classifies survey verbatims into ARR-weighted friction drivers, excludes null scores from averages, and catches explicit churn intent.
Validates customer support diagnostic trees via BFS/DFS for cycles, dead-end questions, orphan nodes, broken refs, and depth.

connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Pull active customer account ARR/renewal windows from Salesforce and open CSM escalation cases, SLA timers, and CSAT verbatims from ServiceNow or Google Sheets via remote_cli mcp before scoring exposure in Python.

gateway_approval_actions: Creating executive customer war-rooms or paging VP sponsors via ServiceNow or Slack
Publishing interactive troubleshooting decision trees to customer-facing portals
python_code_guardrails: Decision-tree DAG cycle, unreachable node, and broken transition reference blocker
Simpson's paradox separation preventing aggregate CSAT averages from hiding enterprise churn signals
Absent ARR/renewal date null preservation (never coercing unknown ARR to zero)

scheduled_routine.name: hourly-vip-escalation-radar
scheduled_routine.title: Hourly VIP Escalation Radar
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the hourly VIP escalation exposure check via scripts/escalation_exposure_scorer.py across open Sev1/Sev2 accounts and renewal windows.
